title: Notes campaign / Friends make notes noteworthy

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Use neighboring wall surfaces to connect a social message with a recognizable brand cue.
strategic_value: A large gradient glyph field can identify Instagram while the adjacent words explain the human value.
demonstration: A street photograph pairs a gradient text wall and shadow imagery with a taller gradient glyph wall behind.
practical_value: Review the relationship between the readable foreground message and the more distant identifying surface.

content_islands.name: Foreground message wall
content_islands.spec: Place the short white phrase on a warm gradient beside the shadow image.

content_islands.name: Raised brand wall
content_islands.spec: Keep the large white glyph on the taller gradient surface visible above the foreground.

reference_purposes.Application: The photograph demonstrates a coordinated multi-surface outdoor campaign.
reference_purposes.Expression: Gradient fields and sparse white type connect the separate walls.
